# ai-brain: AI research knowledge base

> A living knowledge base of findings, gotchas and decisions about the Claude API, agents and AI
> tooling, shared by a family of sibling knowledge bases that use the same format.

The knowledge base is in docs/knowledge/. Every page starts with YAML front matter (title, summary,
topic, status, last_reviewed) validated against docs/knowledge/schema/. Pages with status `plan`
describe intended work, not facts, and claims marked *unverified* are not yet confirmed. To
contribute, open a KB feedback or known-error issue; changes land only through reviewed pull requests.

## Knowledge base

- [Knowledge base](docs/knowledge/README.md): What this knowledge base is, how it's organised, and how to add to it safely (status: verified)
- [Upstream asks for Anthropic](docs/knowledge/anthropic/upstream-contributions.md): Gaps, API asks and doc fixes we could raise with Anthropic, with evidence (status: verified)
- [Claude API](docs/knowledge/claude-api/README.md): Models and model choice, prompt caching, rate limits, spend and keys per app, refusals and fallbacks (status: partial)
- [Agents and Claude Code](docs/knowledge/agents/README.md): Claude Code, cloud sessions, MCP servers, skills, sub-agents and guardrails for agents that act (status: partial)
- [Prompting](docs/knowledge/prompting/README.md): System prompts, audience-specific prompts and structured output that held up in real apps (status: partial)
- [Prompt library](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/README.md): Reusable, generalized prompts for the work and research we do: paste one, fill its placeholders, run it (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Adopt a hub decision in a sibling project](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/adopt-family-decision.md): Asks a sibling project to record a hub decision as its own copy, install the machinery from the hub's export and pilot it (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Apply red-team findings in another project](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/apply-red-team-fixes.md): Hands a red-team findings file to the project that owns the design, to fix, accept or dispute each finding through pull requests (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Back up a Claude project's setup as a note](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/back-up-project-setup.md): Has a Claude project describe its own setup (instructions, repos, model, scheduled tasks, connectors) as one linked note, with secrets, IDs and private data left out (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Summarize the weekly KB digest](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/digest-summary.md): Has a scheduled Claude routine turn the raw kb-digest issue into the handful of changes that matter, read from the sources, and open one PR of KB adds (status: partial)
- [Prompt: Finisher loop](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/finisher-loop.md): Has Claude sweep open PRs, handoffs and threads across the owner's repos and post one numbered list of what waits on them, answerable from chat (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Draft a handoff issue for another project](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/handoff-issue.md): Has the sending project turn an ask into a decision-0012 handoff issue in the receiving repo, waiting for the owner's label (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Survey a tool landscape for the KB](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/landscape-survey.md): Has Claude survey open-source and vendor tools in an area, check licences and dates, red team the result and add it to the KB (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Move sensitive OneNote notebooks to markdown safely](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/onenote-to-markdown.md): Has an organization-approved Claude walk you through backing up, converting with onenote-md-exporter and verifying OneNote notebooks, with no data lost or leaked (status: partial)
- [Prompt: Outside review request](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/outside-review.md): Has a thread write one self-contained file for another company's assistant to review a high-stakes design, then triage the reply (status: partial)
- [Prompt: Park an idea for later](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/park-an-idea.md): Has Claude file a researched side idea as one note in the owner's private parked-ideas folder, with findings, why it's parked and when to revisit (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Standing instructions for a Claude project](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/project-instructions.md): Project-instruction lines the owner pastes into a new Claude project: model, red team, closeout, handoffs and guardrails (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Red team a design or decision](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/red-team.md): Has a second model attack a design, spec or decision record, returning numbered findings with severity, a fix and what's acceptable as is (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Act on a repo conventions audit](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/repo-audit.md): Has Claude turn the owner's pasted repo-audit summary into a numbered fix list: settings fixes the owner runs, handoff issues for file drift (status: partial)
- [Prompt: Research how a project could use a set of tools](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/research-proposal.md): Research-and-proposal only: evaluates candidate tools against a project's real architecture and threat model and returns a ranked recommendation (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Set up a brand profile in a repo](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/set-up-brand-profile.md): Has a project write brand/profile.json from the brand files its repo already has, with a test that keeps it equal to the stylesheet (status: partial)
- [Prompt: Thread closeout](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/thread-closeout.md): The closeout a thread runs before its final reply: lessons to the project KB, and to shared or private layers only after the owner's yes (status: verified)
- [Prompt: Work the handoffs](docs/knowledge/prompting/library/work-the-handoffs.md): Has a receiving project check its repos' handoff issues and pick up the live ones, following decision 0012's pickup rules (status: verified)
- [Evals and testing](docs/knowledge/evals/README.md): Testing features built on LLMs: unit tests for guardrails, LLM-as-judge and regression checks (status: plan)
- [Privacy and safety](docs/knowledge/privacy-and-safety/README.md): Keys and secrets, prompt injection, local-only designs, building AI features for kids, and open-source AI tools for fighting bad actors (status: partial)
- [Platforms for AI apps](docs/knowledge/platforms/README.md): Hosting AI apps: serverless workers, Cloudflare Access, iOS home-screen apps, sign-in inside app wrappers, calling GitHub's API, local GPUs for media models, paying for media at low volume (status: verified)
- [Learning AI](docs/knowledge/learning/README.md): Courses, docs, cookbooks and people worth following to learn how to build with AI (status: plan)
- [Known errors](docs/knowledge/troubleshooting/README.md): Errors hit with the Claude API, SDKs, agents and AI tooling: symptom, cause, fix and source (status: verified)
- [Keeping the knowledge base current](docs/knowledge/curation.md): How the KB stays current: the weekly digest, the prior-art check, the feedback loop, the freshness check and family alignment (status: verified)
- [Experts we follow](docs/knowledge/experts.md): How we choose which people on the Claude API, agents and AI tooling the KB follows: the method, the scores and the list (status: verified)

## Structured data

- [Known errors](docs/knowledge/troubleshooting/known-errors.yaml): symptom, cause, fix and source for errors hit with the Claude API and AI tooling
- [Upstream asks](docs/knowledge/anthropic/upstream.yaml): gaps and asks for Anthropic's API, SDKs and tools, with evidence and status
- [Field reports](docs/knowledge/field-reports.yaml): what worked or broke when someone followed the KB
- [Experts study](docs/knowledge/experts.yaml): people the KB follows, with scores, evidence and the feeds watched
- [Family](docs/knowledge/family.yaml): the sibling knowledge bases and the format version each follows
- [Schemas](docs/knowledge/schema/page.schema.json): JSON Schemas for page front matter and the YAML files above

## Decisions

- [0001. Adopt the family knowledge base format, version 1](docs/knowledge/decisions/0001-adopt-family-kb-format.md): proposed
- [0002. A public AI research KB, kept separate from personal notes](docs/knowledge/decisions/0002-public-kb-separate-from-personal-notes.md): proposed
- [0003. The Claude API is the model provider, with a separate workspace per app](docs/knowledge/decisions/0003-claude-api-as-model-provider.md): proposed
- [0004. This KB is the family's source of truth for Claude API topics](docs/knowledge/decisions/0004-source-of-truth-for-claude-api-topics.md): proposed
- [0005. Family format: per-page review windows and revisit dates on decisions](docs/knowledge/decisions/0005-family-format-review-windows-and-revisit-dates.md): proposed
- [0006. One convention for using Claude models, piloted on the family, with per-project overrides](docs/knowledge/decisions/0006-model-selection-convention.md): proposed
- [0007. Family format: this KB is the source of truth for the format, and templates are generated from it](docs/knowledge/decisions/0007-family-format-ai-brain-as-format-source.md): accepted
- [0008. Family format: maintainer directives and a pause switch](docs/knowledge/decisions/0008-family-format-maintainer-directives-and-pause-switch.md): accepted
- [0009. Claude stays primary; Grok is the one second model family, for named jobs only](docs/knowledge/decisions/0009-second-model-family.md): proposed
- [0010. Family format: link to upstream sources of truth, check against them, and give back](docs/knowledge/decisions/0010-family-format-upstream-sources.md): proposed
- [0011. Family format: enforce knowledge capture with a Stop hook, a PR check and a thread closeout](docs/knowledge/decisions/0011-family-format-enforced-kb-capture.md): accepted
- [0012. Family format: handoffs between Claude projects go through a `handoff` issue in the receiving repo](docs/knowledge/decisions/0012-family-format-handoff-issues.md): accepted
- [0013. One 2ndbrain template, set up as public or private, private by default](docs/knowledge/decisions/0013-one-2ndbrain-template-private-by-default.md): accepted
- [0014. Family format: GitHub work conventions, with low-risk pull requests merging themselves on green](docs/knowledge/decisions/0014-family-format-auto-merge-low-risk-prs.md): proposed
- [0015. A personal swarm on the 2ndbrain, built from the roles that already run](docs/knowledge/decisions/0015-personal-swarm-on-the-2ndbrain.md): proposed
- [0016. Secrets: one password manager as the master copy, keys only in each service's own secret store](docs/knowledge/decisions/0016-secrets-handling.md): accepted
- [0017. Outside review: high-stakes work gets one pass from another company's model, through a file](docs/knowledge/decisions/0017-outside-review-for-high-stakes-work.md): accepted
- [0018. Family format: a stronger leak check and reviewed model-drafted entries](docs/knowledge/decisions/0018-family-format-stronger-leak-check.md): proposed
- [0019. Family format: this hub and the private layer are the default home for every domain](docs/knowledge/decisions/0019-family-format-hub-and-private-layer-by-default.md): proposed

## Related knowledge bases

- [Nerdio HCL kit](https://github.com/nickprignano/nerdio-hcl/tree/main/docs/knowledge): Nerdio Manager on Azure Virtual Desktop, deployed with Terraform and Packer. Source of truth for: Nerdio Manager; the nerdio/nme provider; this kit's Terraform and Packer
- AVD (repo not linked yet): Azure Virtual Desktop itself. Source of truth for: Azure Virtual Desktop platform; FSLogix; session host images in general
- [Liquidware](https://github.com/nickprignano/avd-liquidware/tree/main/docs/knowledge): Liquidware products on virtual desktops. Source of truth for: Liquidware products
- Private layer (repo not linked yet): The maintainer's private wisdom layer. It reads the family through this hub and sends directives here as pull requests; its contents stay private. Source of truth for: Directives to the family; through docs/knowledge/directives.yaml

## Optional

- [Curator sources](docs/knowledge/sources.toml): the feeds and repos the weekly digest watches
